# Phase Three — Final Revelation Before Code

The Awtsmoos is infinite without clutter, simple without lack;
Awtsmoos.com should let every doorway emerge when summoned, then fold the constellation back.

## Final critique

The first idea was to make every app/game immediately visible. That would satisfy breadth but violate the user's stronger visual requirement: simple, clean, futuristic, retractable. The improved interpretation is complete discoverability through a calm launcher whose sections expand only when wanted. Search temporarily expands relevant groups. Nothing important is hidden permanently; nothing noisy is forced into the first frame.

## Thirty final improvements over the earlier plan

1. Preserve top-level Core worlds above generated catalog groups.
2. Use exact source catalogs, never duplicate app/game metadata.
3. Normalize relative catalog hrefs to absolute public routes centrally.
4. Prefix generated ids by group to prevent collisions.
5. Distinguish App vs Game visibly but minimally.
6. Keep descriptions to one concise line with truncation.
7. Collapse large groups by default on narrow screens.
8. Keep Apps and Games expanded on desktop only if viewport height allows.
9. Search expands matching groups automatically.
10. Clearing search restores user-chosen collapse state.
11. Use native `button` controls for section headers.
12. Announce result counts accessibly.
13. Preserve arrow-key card navigation.
14. Make collapse state keyboard reachable.
15. Use CSS grid auto-fit rather than fixed card counts.
16. Use subtle opacity/translate reveals below 180ms.
17. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
18. Avoid blur-heavy effects on mobile GPUs.
19. Avoid continuous animation inside launcher cards.
20. Keep launcher internal scrolling sovereign; body should not jump.
21. Prevent focus from landing in collapsed groups.
22. Escape closes the whole launcher from anywhere inside.
23. Keep input/search sticky on mobile drawer.
24. Show total catalog count in existing launcher heading.
25. Keep direct homepage navigation unchanged.
26. Derive Games storefront counts from `GAMES.length` where possible.
27. Add a catalog completeness audit comparing real first-level launchable directories with registry routes.
28. Require HTTP/load smoke proof before publishing missing candidate routes.
29. Exclude folders whose only entry is tests/debug/internal or whose launch fails.
30. Record every excluded route and reason in durable audit notes so future agents do not rediscover ambiguity.

## Final implementation order

1. Compute app/game filesystem versus catalog delta.
2. Smoke-check every missing route.
3. Classify public candidates and exclusions.
4. Add catalog records in the narrowest leaf modules only where proven.
5. Create homepage constellation normalizer and grouped launcher model.
6. Read current launcher renderer/filter/composition fully.
7. Rewrite those files whole only if required; otherwise add new modules and adjust one composition root.
8. Add grouped futuristic CSS as a separate module and load it without rewriting dirty root HTML if the existing CSS aggregator supports imports.
9. Run catalog tests and completeness audit.
10. Browser-test homepage launcher desktop/mobile/search/collapse/keyboard.
11. Browser-smoke all newly exposed routes.
12. Fix only actual issues found on those routes.
13. Re-read all touched files and compare git diff against the original plan.

## Files expected to be touched

New files are preferred: homepage constellation normalization, grouped launcher state, grouped CSS, completeness test, and audit ledger. Existing catalog leaf modules may be rewritten completely for missing records. Existing launcher modules may be rewritten only after full reads. The dirty root `index.html` should remain untouched unless there is no other legitimate load path for the new CSS/JS.
